snippet: Design proposal received: 'MacDuff' target price $1500-$2500, 20k annual volume.
Industrial Design concepts reviewed: 'Modern', 'High-End', and 'The Show'.
Base Assembly Rev 6 released. Foundation for chassis architecture.
Proto 3 BOM Release. Vendors: Vowin (Proto), Mass (Metal), Fineline (Plastic).
Production BOM Release. Vendors shifted: Yomura (Plastics), Nissha (Front Bezel).
PRODUCT LAUNCH: Cinema One (Model K0503-0100) enters market.
Engineering Change Order: 'Beefed-up' HDD bracket (Rev 6) released to stop lid crashing.
Field Failure: Optical drive grinding noise. Unit replacement required.
Investigation: Discs stuck inside units. Root cause suspected: foam compression failure.
Manufacturing Error: 'Disc sticking out at front slot'. Fixed by replacing pinch roller.
Shipping Damage: Units arriving with deformed bottom chassis. Shockwatch labels proposed.
Field Hack: Customer extracting discs with a butter knife.
Run-In Software Update (A53) deployed to address disc handling failures.
Forensic Analysis: UK unit returned coated in dust. 'Saharan dust' event blamed.
Vendor Admission: RubberTek confirms 'Dirty rollers cause disc slippage'.
Design Iteration: 'All-in-One' metal lid concepts circulating.
Thermal Crisis: Unit shutting down. Fan running at 94% PWM (2453 RPM).
Documentation: 'Cosmetic and Graphic Spec Rev 3' released.
Cost Analysis: Metal Base is $40.45; Paint alone accounts for $16.00.
Escalation 705: Multiple units failing ejection. Replacement drives ineffective.
Vendor Triage: Yomura sending reworked cover samples to mitigate cosmetic failures.
LINE DOWN: Production halted. 'Yields have not been good... currently OOS'.
Vendor Concession Request: Yomura asks to accept flow marks to clear line-down.
Shortage Alert: Mass Precision short 160pcs of TPXS-4MM-12 screws.
Supply Chain Critical: 250 reworked covers needed immediately to finish build.
Design Flaw Note: 'Starved Bezel Vent' observed on related Sundance project.
Process Failure: Units built from 'beta build' stock, bypassing official QC.
